title: NEAR Intents October 1 exploit (deposit-notification bug, $3.8M ghost funds)
token_label: USDT (BNB Chain) via HOT Omni Bridge, 18 decimals

sources.label: Postmortem: NEAR Intents October 1 Exploit (Alex Shevchenko, X article)
Easily Explaining the NEAR Intents Exploit: $3.8M in Ghost Funds, 100% Recovered (The Coding, Substack)

quotes.detection_gap: The internal systems of NEAR Intents had been monitoring the discrepancies of the origin chain and total NEAR-side token balances, but they did not monitor the discrepancies of the total balances of all users on NEAR Intents and the token balance of the Intents contract.
quotes.fix: We have introduced the monitoring of the total balance of NEAR Intents users vs. the balance of the contract. In case the invariant fails, the contract is paused automatically.
quotes.outcome: The attacker returned the full $3.8 million in funds and all affected users were made whole.
